```yaml
name: Test Copilot GitHub Integration
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          go mod download
          go install github.com/golang/mock/mockgen@latest

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          go test ./... -v

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          go build -o gh-aw ./cmd/gh-aw

      - name: Test compile command with default behavior
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile
          ls -la .github/instructions/
          ls -la .github/prompts/

      - name: Test compile command with --no-instructions flag
        run: |
          rm -rf .github/instructions .github/prompts
          ./gh-aw compile --no-instructions
          if [ -d ".github/instructions" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Instructions directory should not exist"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -d ".github/prompts" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Prompts directory should not exist"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate instruction files exist by default
        run: |
          ./gh-aw compile
          if [ ! -f ".github/instructions/github-agentic-workflows.instructions.md" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Instruction file not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -f ".github/prompts/create-agentic-workflow.prompt.md" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Prompt file not found"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Test with --no-emit flag (should skip both lock and instruction files)
        run: |
          rm -rf .github/instructions .github/prompts
          ./gh-aw compile --no-emit
          if [ -d ".github/instructions" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Instructions directory should not exist with --no-emit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -d ".github/prompts" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: Prompts directory should not exist with --no-emit"
            exit 1
          fi
```
